floor_history.headline: Confirmed floor 4 (vu32 single-store); killed instance hypothesis that a minimal single-statement body reaches $t9; grant's fold claim only wrong for the volatile reading; sibling has independent hand

Resolved s1 frontier item 1: $t9 IS reachable by genuine register pressure (N>=22 live scratch pseudos, no REG_ALLOC_ORDER override for MIPS), but only at the cost of a 110-insn body with $s0-$s7 save

frontier.hypothesis: Trailing double-nop after jr $ra is source-level, unexplained by any lever tried so far (unchanged from s1).
frontier.mechanism: unknown; not inter-object padding, not GTE/cop2 latency
frontier.next_probe: Grep other matched leaf functions in this codebase for a jr $ra; nop; nop (double-nop) 6+-insn shape and read their matched C to see what source construct, if any, produces a second nop after the return in a leaf void function.

frontier.hypothesis: A differently-shaped pressure chassis (e.g. 22+ live call-clobbered temporaries with no $s0-$s7 involvement, if such a shape exists under MIPS's calling convention) might reach $t9 without the save/restore overhead this session's chassis incurred.
frontier.mechanism: global.c allocation order is fixed (ascending, no REG_ALLOC_ORDER), but which hard regs get claimed depends on which pseudos conflict; this session only tried one liveness-shaping idiom (declare-first, use-last pointers).
frontier.next_probe: Try a chassis using genuinely call-clobbered-only values (e.g. values live only across straight-line code with no calls, forcing the compiler toward $t0-$t9 before $s0-$s7 if any such preference exists elsewhere, e.g. local-alloc.c's class preferences) to see if $t9 is reachable at lower N without s-register save overhead.

frontier.hypothesis: Re-weigh the canonical-asm grant -- this session's pressure-threshold finding is now additional evidence AGAINST a small natural-C body reaching $t9, strengthening (not yet conclusively) the case for keeping the hand-written-asm reading alongside the sibling func_80052C28 marker.
frontier.next_probe: If frontier item 2 (alternate chassis shape) also fails to reach $t9 without prologue overhead, that is a stronger basis for a ruling-request than currently exists; otherwise keep gathering before escalating unilaterally.

kills.statement: A single-statement body `*(T *)0x1F800400 = 0;` (volatile vu32 or plain s32 pointer form) reaches the target's $t9 register seat for the scratchpad address pseudo.
kills.measured_on: src/main/3AB48.c func_80052C10, single-statement chassis `*(vu32 *)0x1F800400 = 0;` and `*(s32 *)0x1F800400 = 0;`, no FAKE construct present, no register pin used
kills.result: Both the vu32 and plain s32 single-statement forms allocate the address pseudo to $v0 (lowest free scratch reg), never $

kills.statement: A body whose total instruction count stays close to the target's 6 insns can reach $t9 via this genuine-pressure mechanism.
kills.measured_on: gen2.py pointer-pressure chassis (declare-target-first, dereference-others-before-target shape), N=5,9,13,15,20,22,23, no FAKE construct, no register pin, measured via .greg dispositions + sandbox --c
kills.result: KILLED on this chassis: every N that reaches $t9 (N>=22) also claims all of $s0-$s7 and incurs a non-trivial save/restor
